agent.question: Which visual projection neurons drive backward walking (retreat) in Drosophila, and is the moonwalker pathway necessary?

hypotheses.text: [H1, agent-generated] [Agent-generated] Optogenetic activation of LC16 drives backward walking (matches gt20/gt21); the simulation should rank LC16 above baseline VPNs despite its connectome rank of 16.
[H3, agent-generated] [Agent-generated, necessity] Silencing MDN abolishes the backward drive evoked by LC16 activation (epistasis); GF/DNp01 silencing does not.
